summary: This document specifies DOTS signal channel Call Home, where a Call Home DOTS server starts a secure connection to a Call Home DOTS client and receives attack traffic information from it. The server uses that to identify compromised devices launching outgoing DDoS attacks and mitigate them. It is not limited to home networks.

eli5.summary: Usually a victim calls for help during an attack. Here the helper calls the victim to learn what attack traffic looks like, so it can stop the bad devices that are sending it.

questions: stop outgoing ddos attacks closer to source
